mission.title: Mission
mission.text:
We believe AI's greatest value is not replacing humans, but making humans more human — more creative, more focused, more able to do what they truly care about.

AI tools keep getting stronger, yet using them feels increasingly fragmented and draining. Developers bounce between agents and sessions, lose hard-won context, and watch their attention leak into the tools themselves instead of the work.

wehuman builds calm tools that give that attention back — so people have more energy for the things only humans can do.
